definition: Large orchestral work, usually in four movements. In 1933 Florence Price became the first Black woman to have a symphony played by a major US orchestra.
Summer squash, also called a courgette. Double Z, double C, double trouble.
Rows of keys for typing or playing music. QWERTY was designed for typewriters, not for you.
A state of not knowing what to do. See also: choosing a Christmas present for your in-laws.
Long-legged wading bird that’s pink because of the pigments in what it eats. Grey chicks, pink adults.
Race of 42.195 km. In 1967 Kathrine Switzer became the first woman to run Boston as an official entrant, despite an official trying to drag her off the course.
